results.userText: What if I changed the grind?
results.text: For Cocoa Garden espresso, a finer grind should slow the shot, while a coarser grind should speed it up. Keep the saved 18 g dose and 36 g output, change only the grind by one small step, and time from pressing the button until stopping at 36 g. Your current setting is 5 on the Barista Express grinder; I’d choose finer or coarser only after knowing whether the shot is running fast, slow, or unevenly.
